channel.title: Thomas Cook — Case Studies
channel.description: Engineering case studies by Thomas Cook, Software Engineer.

item.title: Android 16 & .NET 10 Migration across Multi-App Ecosystem (HWM)
item.description: Migrated multiple enterprise applications at HWM from .NET 9 to .NET 10, and upgraded a cross-platform .NET MAUI mobile application to target Android 16 (SDK 36). The upgrade has been merged and released.

item.title: API Performance Optimization & Systems Integration (HWM)
item.description: An optimization initiative executed at HWM that successfully reduced core API response times by 60% across 9 cycles of Shape Up product development, supporting system-wide stability and bug reduction.

item.title: Migrating Four Apps from .NET 9 to .NET 10: Package Versions, Pipelines and File Conversion
item.description: Migrated four connected applications from .NET 9 to .NET 10. The migration itself was mostly mechanical, but three things caused real work: package version conflicts that broke the release pipelines, odd behaviour changes in the backend file conversion code, and starting later than would have been ideal.

item.title: Proprietary Internal Product Development
item.description: A highly successful, proprietary business solution designed, architected, and built from the ground up to streamline operations and generate new revenue streams.

item.title: Rolling Out k6 Load Testing and Finding What It Caught
item.description: Owned the adoption of k6 performance and load testing, from choosing the tool through rolling it out to the team. It exposed major weak points across the majority of the applications tested that the previous testing approach had missed. The fixes that followed improved response times by 18.3%.
